headlines.description: — Jordan Love realizes the Green Bay Packers need to finish better.
headlines.shortLinkText: Love throws 3 TD passes as the Packers beat the Panthers 27-19

events.name: Carolina Panthers at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: — With Josh Allen at quarterback, anything seems possible for the Buffalo Bills — including overcoming a sloppy first half.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bills cruise in 2nd half to 36-10 win over Ravens, who lose QBs Jackson and Huntley to injuries

headlines.description: — Bengals defensive tackle Dexter Lawrence had some simple advice for Joe Burrow as the franchise quarterback prepared to take the field with Cincinnati trailing the Tennessee Titans by a touchdown in the fourth quarter.
headlines.shortLinkText: Joe Burrow throws 5 TD passes, then runs for score in OT as Bengals rally for 43-36 win over Titans

headlines.description: — Tyler Allgeier jolted his Arizona offense, which gave Gardner Minshew and Michael Wilson a chance to stun the Dallas Cowboys.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chad Ryland kicks winner after PAT miss that forced OT as Cards beat Cowboys 33-30 with wild rally

headlines.description: — The Detroit Lions handed the Minnesota Vikings their first loss of the season and had a muted celebration because All-Pro linebacker
headlines.shortLinkText: Goff throws go-ahead touchdown pass to Williams and Lions beat Vikings 19-15 for their 1st loss

headlines.description: — Kirk Cousins got up after his 1-yard touchdown run, crouched near the Raiders' sideline and started flapping his right elbow like a chicken wing.
headlines.shortLinkText: Raiders rally past the Jets 38-33 as Kirk Cousins leads a comeback to snap a 4-game skid

events.name: Las Vegas Raiders at New York Jets

headlines.description: — The Pittsburgh Steelers spent all week hearing the chatter coming from Cleveland, then spent all Sunday emphatically and repeatedly putting their longtime rivals in their place.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers bulldoze Browns 27-6 to take AFC North lead, extend home streak over rivals to 23 straight

headlines.description: — Baker Mayfield threw more downfield blocks than he had completions.
headlines.shortLinkText: Buccaneers beat Falcons 16-0 despite failing to complete a single pass in wet, sloppy conditions

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: — The Jacksonville Jaguars' latest home blowout gave them a three-game lead in the AFC South — and put them in a spot they haven't been in since 1999.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jaguars deliver big plays on both sides of the ball in 42-7 romp over rebuilding Colts

headlines.description: — Aaron Donald sprinted after Justin Herbert's loose fumble with almost nothing but open turf between him and his first touchdown for the Los Angeles Rams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Matthew Stafford and Rams overcome slow start, rally past winless Chargers 24-9

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: — The one thing the Denver Broncos do really well is win close games.
headlines.shortLinkText: On fourth-and-goal, Roach drops Mahomes and flips the AFC West race as Broncos beat Chiefs 28-24

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: — Drake Maye was without a pair of top receivers and a running back Sunday against the Miami Dolphins.
headlines.shortLinkText: Maye has 3 touchdowns as Patriots rally to beat Dolphins 24-19

events.name: New England Patriots at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: — The Washington Commanders had just under two weeks to sit with their disheartening start to the season before their matchup against the Philadelphia Eagles on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jayden Daniels throws TD pass and Commanders shut out Eagles over final 3 quarters in 27-10 win

headlines.description: — Jeffery Simmons ran out of the tunnel for the first time since joining the Chicago Bears with a new uniform, orange sleeves and a wide smile as he welcomed the move that put right into contention...
headlines.shortLinkText: Caleb Williams and Jeffery Simmons lead the Bears past the Seahawks 34-17
